related.title: 維京聯網直流互聯
related.transfer: 可遷移「一小時省下的水」與「直流線路損失」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；維京聯網直流互聯的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Water saved in one hour" and "DC line loss" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Viking Link HVDC Interconnector must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦七百二十公里的海底電纜把英國的風接上挪威的水庫：價差收入、省下的水、電纜的重量、深水敷設與最大單一事故；維京聯網直流互聯則以連接英國與丹麥的最長聯網線：兩地風電的互補、啟用初期的容量限制、陸纜的接頭與溫升、磁場與埋設為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A 720-kilometre subsea cable joining British wind to Norwegian reservoirs: spread income, water saved, cable weight, deep-water laying and the largest single loss; Viking Link HVDC Interconnector centres on the longest interconnector, joining Britain and Denmark: complementary wind, early capacity limit, land cable joints and heating, magnetic field and burial, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「價差與擁塞收入」與「兩地風電的互補」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「換流站損失」的模型移到維京聯網直流互聯，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「直流線路損失」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Price spread and congestion income" and "How two wind fleets complement each other".
Move the model of "Converter-station losses" to Viking Link HVDC Interconnector, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "DC line loss", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「一小時省下的水」與「直流線路損失」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；維京聯網直流互聯的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Water saved in one hour" and "DC line loss" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Viking Link HVDC Interconnector must be respecified.

related.title: 張北柔性直流電網
related.transfer: 可遷移「一小時省下的水」與「直流線路損失」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；張北柔性直流電網的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Water saved in one hour" and "DC line loss" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Zhangbei VSC-HVDC Grid must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦七百二十公里的海底電纜把英國的風接上挪威的水庫：價差收入、省下的水、電纜的重量、深水敷設與最大單一事故；張北柔性直流電網則以世界第一個直流電網：四端環網、年輸送電量、子模組電容的儲能、故障電流的上升率與直流斷路器為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A 720-kilometre subsea cable joining British wind to Norwegian reservoirs: spread income, water saved, cable weight, deep-water laying and the largest single loss; Zhangbei VSC-HVDC Grid centres on the first DC grid in the world: a four-terminal ring, yearly energy, energy in submodule capacitors, fault current rise and DC breakers, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「價差與擁塞收入」與「年輸送電量占北京用電的比例」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「換流站損失」的模型移到張北柔性直流電網，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「直流故障電流的上升率」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Price spread and congestion income" and "Yearly energy as a share of Beijing demand".
Move the model of "Converter-station losses" to Zhangbei VSC-HVDC Grid, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Rate of rise of DC fault current", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「一小時省下的水」與「直流線路損失」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；張北柔性直流電網的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Water saved in one hour" and "DC line loss" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Zhangbei VSC-HVDC Grid must be respecified.

history.titleEn: North Sea Link Subsea HVDC Interconnector
history.text: 2015 年兩國的電網公司決定投資；2018 年海底電纜開始敷設；2021 年聯網線開始運轉。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
